answer: Each name is charged a waiting period of 30 days that no payment can shorten, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Every entry must show Proclaimed vine dresser valley charter before the ledger opens, because a charter dressers hold after vine inspections. The tundra is checked, not assumed. One wander, one entry. The atlas is on the docket.
